email.subject: AI for Selendy Gay, built for your appellate and commercial litigation practice
email.body:
Hi Jennifer,

With $40+ billion recovered for clients, Selendy Gay has built something rare: a plaintiffs' practice that competes with BigLaw on every front. That scale of impact requires precision at every stage, especially in appellate work and complex commercial disputes.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built specifically for firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what actually matters: precision, client trust, and the ability to move faster without sacrificing quality.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms like yours compete with larger players.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
